text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the end of the year. Tokai Teio goes to the Nakayama Racecourse to watch Symboli Rudolf compete in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing Symboli Rudolf absolutely dominate the race, Tokai Teio truly feels the difference between her and her hero.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her wish to stand on the same level as Symboli Rudolf doesn't change.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll never give up, no matter how treacherous the journey. Tokai Teio hardens her resolve once more.
